title: Relativistic corrections: aberration, gravitational deflection, meff
description:
Port the standalone relativistic correction functions from sweph.c into a new `src/corrections.rs` module. These are pure math functions called by the apparent position pipeline.

## Functions to implement

### 1. `aberr_light(xx: &mut [f64; 6], earth_vel: &[f64; 3])` (sweph.c:3699)
Special-relativistic Lorentz transform for annual aberration.
- Earth velocity input in AU/day, internally convert to units of c: `v[i] = vel[i] / (CLIGHT * AUNIT * 86400)`... actually the C uses `vel[i] / (CLIGHT / AUNIT / 86400)`. Extract exact formula from c-ref-calc.md.
- β = √(1 − v²), f₁ = (û·v⃗)/|û|, f₂ = 1 + f₁/(1+β)
- x_apparent = (β·x + f₂·|û|·v) / (1 + f₁)
- Speed: NOT corrected by this function (caller handles via finite differences)

### 2. `deflect_light(xx: &mut [f64; 6], earth_helio: &[f64; 3], planet_helio: &[f64; 3])` (sweph.c:3743)
GR light bending by the Sun.
- û = planet geocentric (unit), ê = Earth helio (unit), q̂ = planet helio (unit)
- g₁ = 2·GM/(c²·AUNIT·rE) · meff, g₂ = 1 + (q̂·ê)
- x_deflected = |U| · (û + (g₁/g₂)·(û·q̂·ê − û·ê·q̂))
- Speed: NOT corrected by this function (caller handles via finite differences at DEFL_SPEED_INTV)

### 3. `meff(r_planet_helio: f64, elongation_cos: f64) -> f64` (sweph.c:~3830)
Effective mass factor that smooths the singularity near the solar disc.
- Tabulated as angle/mass pairs, linearly interpolated
- Extract exact table from c-ref-calc.md

## Constants to add
- `DEFL_SPEED_INTV: f64 = 0.0000005` (days, ~43ms) — in constants.rs

## Module setup
- Create `src/corrections.rs`, add `pub mod corrections;` to lib.rs
- All functions are `pub` for use by the calc pipeline

C source reference: docs/c-ref-calc.md (produced by swisseph-rs/28)

acceptance_criteria.text: aberr_light, deflect_light, meff implemented in src/corrections.rs
C golden test harness (gen_corrections.c) exercises both functions with diverse input positions
Bitwise-exact match with C output for all test cases

execution_record: Implemented in two commits: 0b247d2 (module + tests), f6837b4 (codebase map). One divergence from plan: the velocity conversion in aberr_light initially used `/ 86400.0` but needed `/ 24.0 / 3600.0` to match C's evaluation order (1-ULP difference). Pipeline golden tests (section 3) load and validate structure but defer full numerical verification to swisseph-rs/30 when the calc pipeline is implemented.
